mapper.select: SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS financialAccountId, fa.owner_type AS ownerType, fa.owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId, fa.bank_name AS bankName, fa.account_number_ciphertext AS accountNumberCiphertext, fa.account_name AS accountName, fa.account_product_type AS accountProductType, fa.account_status AS accountStatus, fa.link_status AS linkStatus, fa.balance AS balance FROM financial_account fa WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{accountId} AND fa.owner_member_id = #{memberId} AND fa.owner_type = 'PARENT' AND fa.account_product_type = 'DEMAND_DEPOSIT' AND fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS financialAccountId, fa.child_id AS childId, fa.owner_type AS ownerType, fa.owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId, fa.bank_name AS bankName, fa.account_number_ciphertext AS accountNumberCiphertext, fa.account_name AS accountName, fa.account_product_type AS accountProductType, fa.account_status AS accountStatus, fa.link_status AS linkStatus, fa.balance AS balance, fga.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId FROM financial_account fa LEFT JOIN financial_goal_account fga ON fga.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_transfer ( child_id, requested_by_member_id, source_account_id, destination_account_id, amount, memo, transfer_type, status, idempotency_key, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{requestedByMemberId}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{destinationAccountId}, #{amount}, #{memo}, 'MANUAL', 'REQUESTED', #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, balance_updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE financial_account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_balance_snapshot ( financial_account_id, child_id, balance, observed_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{childId}, #{balance}, #{observedAt} )

INSERT INTO account_transaction ( financial_account_id, counterparty_account_id, child_id, transaction_fingerprint, occurred_at, direction, amount, balance_after, description, counterparty_name, source_type, recorded_at ) VALUES ( #{financialAccountId}, #{counterpartyAccountId}, #{childId}, #{transactionFingerprint}, #{occurredAt}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, #{counterpartyName}, 'TRANSFER', #{occurredAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT ft.financial_transfer_id AS financialTransferId, fga.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, ft.requested_by_member_id AS requestedByMemberId, ft.source_account_id AS sourceAccountId, ft.destination_account_id AS destinationAccountId, ft.amount, ft.memo, ft.transfer_type AS transferType, ft.status, ft.failure_code AS failureCode, ft.failure_message AS failureMessage, ft.account_transaction_id AS matchedTransactionId, ft.requested_at AS requestedAt, ft.completed_at AS completedAt FROM financial_transfer ft INNER JOIN financial_account dst ON dst.financial_account_id = ft.destination_account_id LEFT JOIN financial_goal_account fga ON fga.financial_account_id = dst.financial_account_id WHERE ft.financial_transfer_id = #{transferId} AND ( ft.requested_by_member_id = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM child_parent cp WHERE cp.child_id = ft.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} ) )
